interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate with GPT-6.2 Sol, implement with Luna-max in Fast mode, and review with Sol at a user-selected reasoning level.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a capability-routed delivery workflow. The primary session and read-only reviewer use GPT-6.2 Sol at a reasoning level selected by the user for each skill run. All implementation work uses GPT-6 Luna at max reasoning. Custom agents inherit the root session's service tier, so select Fast for the root session to run Luna in Fast mode; that speed also applies to the orchestrator and reviewer.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Route this implementation through the appropriate Sol Advisor lane.
Review this deliverable with the matching read-only reviewer before reporting done.
